propositions: Four model-provenance guard tests each independently call _run_request_sites(), causing the same whole-tree AST analysis to run four times per test process

_run_request_sites internally performs redundant full-tree parsing: _verdict re-parses every file once per parameter-provenance site, and _functions parses the whole tree again, resulting in ~8,033 parses for a single scan

The AST analysis is a pure function of committed src/rebar source code with no test-time mutations and no dependency on autouse fixture patches, making it safe to cache across the four guard invocations

Session-scoped fixture and functools.cache memoization on per-path parse removes both layers of repetition (inter-test and intra-scan) while preserving all 24 (key, expr, verdict) tuples identically and catching seeded defects correctly
Module wall-clock time reduces from 50.14s to 5.96s (-88%) and _run_request_sites invocation count drops from 4 to 1, with no on-disk artifacts or cross-session staleness
